brand.intro: I’m Paul Rabas. I create honest, useful content about places, people, public life, and the questions we encounter every day.
brand.footer_tagline: Stories worth seeing. Information worth knowing.

about.heading: Curiosity led me here.
about.lead: I’ve spent much of my professional life inside public service, legislative work, and writing. That experience taught me to ask better questions, find the point, and explain it clearly.
about.body: Paul Today is where that instinct meets the things I genuinely enjoy: good food, unfamiliar places, public events, social interactions, and stories that help people understand their city a little better.
